name: violet-intern-project
description: Kabalan construction portfolio and content-management app

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,green "npm --prefix client run dev" "npm --prefix server run dev"
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
